integrity: The residue argument is exhaustive over all 121 ordered residue pairs and treats every variable template symbol adversarially, so it proves all quotient lifts rather than extrapolating from finite prefixes. Power-freeness is independently reduced to fixed residue mismatches, four exhaustive short periods, and the classical cube-freeness of Thue-Morse.
scientific_limitations: The twenty modulo-eleven classes are a sufficient family for one fixed morphic word, not a complete characterization of that word's pseudoperiods or of all pairs satisfying the conjecture. The full binary pseudoperiod avoidance conjecture remains open.
title: Ten modulo-eleven residue pairs give one power-free pseudoperiodic family
